item.subject: science
item.stem:
Leela wants the density of a small glass marble. She will measure its mass on a digital balance and its volume with a measuring cylinder partly filled with water.

Which claims about the correct procedure are true? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: If the digital balance does not show zero, she must bring it to zero before measuring the mass of the marble.
options.B: She should find the volume of the marble from the rise in water level in the measuring cylinder.
options.C: She can skip bringing the digital balance to zero because the mass of the marble does not depend on the starting reading.
options.D: She should estimate the volume of the marble from its outline alone, without using the measuring cylinder.
